response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, '(missing)') AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS conserved_site_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS share_of_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat ORDER BY s.insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: Count distinct sites with at least one conservation record in each insurance-status group, so multiple records for one site count once.
